items.title: Sangam Warriors | Official Team Anthem
items.content_html:
Official Team Anthem

Project Overview

The official team anthem for Sangam Warriors, a kabaddi team competing in the Uttarakhand Premier Kabaddi League (UPKL). The project involved creating an original song to capture the team's identity and the energy of the sport.

I handled the complete song creation and audio production. The visuals were handled separately.

My Contribution

  • Lyrics and songwriting
  • Music composition
  • Vocal performance
  • Music production and arrangement
  • Audio mixing
  • Audio mastering

items.title: AAP Bihar | Social Media Research & Copywriting
items.summary: Project Overview A collection of social media content developed for AAP Bihar,…
items.content_html:
Project Overview

A collection of social media content developed for AAP Bihar, comprising over 100 tweets. The work involved researching relevant subjects and developing written content for the organisation's social media communication. The eight samples featured here represent a selection from the larger body of work.

My Contribution

I was responsible for researching topics, gathering relevant information and writing the tweets. My role covered research and copywriting across the collection of 100+ social media posts.
